headline: Director At F5 Sells $1.56M Of Stock
summary:
RAMESH NIKHIL MEHTA, Director at F5 (NASDAQ:FFIV), executed a substantial insider sell on August 3, according to an SEC filing.
What Happened: A Form 4 filing from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday
